snippet.title: Sans & Papyrus - Salsa Lesson - Full Game Showcase
snippet.description:
Download Link: https://gamejolt.com/games/watch_learn_how_to_shoot_gangsta_style_video/990980
--------------------------------------------------------------------------
IDUTSHANE was supposed to receive the same treatment content wise, with a trailer followed up with a showcase video, however we never managed to get the trailer done in time so the only thing we ever got to publish was the showcase portion of the rollout. Really glad I managed to do this with Salsa however. Thats it from me content wise, see you guys next time

CREDITS:
Mehigh : main coder, writer, artist, gore
@TraXsus : coding assistance, main artist
@shortmonqey : optimized most of the code
dELTA : main artist (https://x.com/delta_valory)
Malk : made abominations, main musician
Shiloh : helped with small tib bits regarding writing and art assets
DA : made the teralazing cover (https://soundcloud.com/radioaman-dokan/teralizing-to-f-r)

@sarcore_ : trailer music
Adafi : helped with writing cutscenes
@segasonic1015  : provided menu ambience
@stretch6706  : helped with overworld npc design
Tyrop : model seen in trailer, helped with trailer
Bon : provided their portrait cover for an ending (https://soundcloud.com/psybon_alt/portraitoftracy)
